from hep_lfx import HepComponent, component, payload
from lfx.io import DataInput, Output
from lfx.schema import Data
class HepScope(HepComponent):
 display_name='核对冻结资产范围'
 inputs=[DataInput(name='value', display_name='value', required=True)]
 outputs=[Output(name="result",display_name="结果",method="build")]
 async def build(self)->Data:
  return Data(data=await component("scope",payload(self.value),self._id))

from hep_lfx import HepComponent, component, payload
from lfx.io import DataInput, Output
from lfx.schema import Data
class HepAssess(HepComponent):
 display_name='核对报告与适用依据'
 inputs=[DataInput(name='value', display_name='value', required=True),DataInput(name='report', display_name='report', required=True),DataInput(name='readiness', display_name='readiness', required=True)]
 outputs=[Output(name="result",display_name="结果",method="build")]
 async def build(self)->Data:
  return Data(data=await component("assess",{**payload(self.value),"report":payload(self.report),"readiness":payload(self.readiness)},self._id))
